title: New Lilo & Stitch Animated Revival Reveals Sneak Peek Clip Ahead of Release in Theaters
content:
Lilo & Stitch is coming to theaters with an animated revival bringing back the classic franchise for a new generation, and a new sneak peek is showing off the first look at its new short in motion. With Disney’s next major outing, Hexed , hitting theaters over the Thanksgiving holiday teasing it’s going to be the end of one era of Walt Disney Animation Studios , it’s incredibly fitting that screenings of the film are going to be offering a first look at what could end up being the start of the next era for the studio.

Lilo & Scratch is a brand new animated short that will be screening ahead of Hexed , and features the original Lilo & Stitch animated incarnations coming back in a whole new kind of way. The most impressive aspect of the new short is the fact that while it looks like the 2D animated original feature film, it’s actually been animated through the CG animation pipeline at the studio to make a cool new kind of end result. You can check it out in motion below with a special sneak peek clip.

Lilo & Scratch Sneak Peek Clip Released Ahead of Hexed Screenings

Lilo & Scratch will be debuting across theaters on November 25th together with screenings of Disney’s Hexed , so you’re going to want to make it to the theater a bit early to make sure to catch the new short in action. Directed by Malcon Pierce and Fawn Veerasunthorn, it’s the first new animated short from Walt Disney Animation Studios in five years. Using the already set CG animation pipeline with the studio, the new short adapts it to the original 2D animation designs that helps to make it a whole new kind of fluid for a new generation of fans.

Maia Kealoha returns from the live-action Lilo & Stitch and its now in the works sequel as Lilo while Chris Sanders reprises his role as Stitch. As the sneak peek teases, Lilo adopts a mysterious cat that is clearly hiding a rambunctiousness that Stitch is likely going to be contending with in secret. It’s not clear how long this new short will last, but it’s certainly an exciting release given that it lays out a potential future for more of this 2D-like animated releases coming from Disney in the future. Which would be a big deal to the older fans.

When Does Lilo & Stitch 2 Come Out?

Lilo & Stitch’ s live-action feature film reboot had been an incredible success for Disney at the box office, and quickly went into development on its sequel. Lilo & Stitch 2 is currently in the works for a release in Summer 2028 , but a concrete release date has yet to be revealed as of this time. Very little has been revealed for the new sequel, but it’s been confirmed that it will be introducing a new take on Angel, who was one of the many Experiments that had been unleashed in the TV animated series.

Lilo & Stitch ‘s live-action reboot had sparked some debates among fans for some of the changes it had made with its ending, and that’s likely going to continue with the sequel as the stars behind it have teased that it’s also going to make changes from the original version . But with a direct to video sequel and a full TV series to draw inspiration from, it’s likely going to be packed with surprises. How are you liking the look of Lilo & Scratch so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Inklore to Release Tomoko Yamashita's Ikoku Nikki Manga on June 8
content:
Inklore revealed on Wednesday the cover art and June 8, 2027 release for the first volume of Tomoko Yamashita 's Ikoku Nikki manga. The company will release the manga under the English title Ikoku Nikki : Diary of a Strange Land .

Inklore describes the manga's first volume:

Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has built a life entirely on her own terms—she's sharp-tongued, set in her ways, and far more at ease with the people she invents than the family she keeps at a distance. But everything changes when her older sister dies unexpectedly, leaving behind a now-orphaned daughter, fifteen-year-old Asa. Every door in the family quietly closes but one . . . Makio's. There starts the unsure journey of a prickly aunt and a grieving niece, figuring each other out one awkward day at a time. Can two people who never expected to need each other make room for a life neither of them planned?

Yamashita ( The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window , Don't Cry Girl , Mo'some Sting ) launched the manga in June 2017 in Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine, and ended it in June 2023. The manga's 11th and final compiled book volume shipped in August 2023. The manga was nominated for the 28th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2024. The manga also ranked at #5 on the women's list of the 2024 edition of Kono Manga ga Sugoi!, topped Da Vinci's 23rd annual "Book of the Year" list for manga in December 2023, and was nominated for the 13th Manga Taisho awards in 2020.

The manga inspired a live-action film that opened in June 2024. The manga then inspired a television anime that debuted on January 4 earlier this year. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with the title Journal with Witch . The anime won one of the four Galaxy Awards for March, and was eventually one of the Encouragement Award winners of the 63rd Galaxy Awards held in June.

Yamashita launched the Tatsumaki manga on Shodensha 's Our Feel web manga site on January 4 earlier this year.

title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 7 Confirms Disney Release Date – Watch Trailer
content:
Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir is coming back to Disney with a new season, and it’s teasing a big and potentially darker direction for the animated series with the first trailer ahead of its launch later this weekend. Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir has been a massively popular fantasy superhero action series ever since it made its debut, and that has continued even further with tons of new episodes, feature films, spinoffs in development and much more over the years . And it’s coming back for more this month.

Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 7 will be coming to the Disney Channel this weekend on Friday, November 20th in the United States to help kick off the global rollout of the new episodes, and it’s teasing new power ups, new transformations, new heroes, new threats, and even a surprsingly dark conspiracy that will challenge Marinette and Adrien more than ever before. You can check out the new trailer for the coming season below for the best look yet and what’s coming our way.

Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Reveals First Look at Season 7

Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 7 will be making its debut in the United States and Latin America (following its release in international territories earlier in the month) on the Disney Channel on Friday, November 20th, and then will be available for streaming with Disney+ on November 21st. Produced in collaboration with Disney Kids & Family, Brazil’s Globosat, Italy’s KidsMe and France’s TF1, this new season of the animated series has confirmed it will be running for 26 episodes. And it’s got some big plans for the future of the franchise.

As Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir continues to expand the franchise with all sorts of new projects , it’s been teased that Season 7 will continue to build on the interconnected universe plan for it all moving forward. The wider universe of the series will be expanding in ways fans might not see coming with all sorts of new surprises being set up for the coming season, and naturally Marinette is going to be at the center of it all as she has to deal with a new kind of enemy that’s going to make it tough to keep her life as a hero separate from her personal life.

What to Know for Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 7

Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 7 teases how Marinette will need to navigate her relationship going forward, “Marinette dreams of enjoying a normal relationship with Adrien, but the secret she carries about his father, Gabriel Agreste, stands in the way. Faced with an impossible choice, she makes a decision that will change everything, affecting her friendships, her relationship with Adrien and her responsibilities as Ladybug.” All the while knowing that a new villain is moving in the shadows with their plan.

Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir is also going to expand its world in a whole new kind of way with a new live-action series now in the works . Miraculous Corp. is working together with See-Saw Films on the new series, but no potential release window or date has been announced as of this time. Are you excited for the new season of Miraculous ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch Anime Gets English Dub
content:
The series debuted on April 12, and it aired for a continuous two cours (quarters of a year) or a half-year run. The anime aired in the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS and 26 other channels on Sundays at 11:30 p.m. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

The anime's English website describes the story:

Witch apprentice Spica Virgo can't use magic at all. To earn a place in the magic school she dreams of entering, she needs a mentor-but she has neither money nor connections. One day, a mysterious black cat who speaks and wields magic appears before her! Spica wants to master sorcery, and the black cat longs to break a curse. The pair's goals align. Thus begins their secret master-apprentice pact! And the key to breaking the curse is a kiss on the...?!

Naoyuki Tatsuwa ( Nisekoi - False Love , Promise of Wizard , Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) directed the anime at LIDEN FILMS . Midori Gotō ( Clean Freak! Aoyama kun , Mr. Villain's Day Off ) was in charge of series scripts, and Takayuki Onoda ( Hortensia Saga ) designed the characters.

Kaneda ( Boarding School Juliet ) launched the manga on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket manga app in March 2022. Kodansha published the manga's 16th compiled book volume on November 9. Kodansha 's K MANGA service publishes the manga in English.

title: Ted: The Animated Series Confirms Return of Peacock Series’ Best Characters With One Glaring Absence
content:
Ted is coming back to Peacock with a new animated series hitting later this December, and the first look at the new show has confirmed that two of the best characters from the live-action TV series are coming back. But there’s still one major absence that fans have immediately noticed. Ted: The Animated Series is a new entry in the wider Ted franchise that picks up 12 years after the events of the feature films , and reintroduces the older John and Ted as they raise their families together.

But with the success of the Ted TV series with Peacock, fans had gotten attached to those earlier depictions of the franchise’s characters . This is especially true for the members of the Bennett family, and thankfully it’s been confirmed that Matty and Susan are set to return to the new animated series with Scott Grimes and Alanna Ubach likely reprising their roles. You can check out the first look at them below, but Giorgia Whigham’s Blaire unfortunately seems unaccounted for right now.

Matty and Susan Return in Ted: The Animated Series

Ted: The Animated Series is set back in the canon of the Ted films, and that means Mark Wahlberg returns as the older version of John for the occasion. The Ted TV series technically was in line with the films, but had taken on a whole life of its own with fans online especially with the different iterations of Matty and Susan Bennett. The TV series had fully invented new versions of John’s parents (who had been portrayed by Ralph Garman and Alex Bortstein in the first Ted film, and even had different names), so it’s a great sign to see them folded into the animated series.

But their return also raises a few questions. It’s likely that Ted: The Animated Series isn’t too concerned with having a tight timeline of events, but Matty and Susan should technically be in the eighties by this point given that they were already a bit older in the 1990s. And through the first trailer, Blaire doesn’t seem to appear either. She was the standout brand new addition to the formula in the TV series, so there’s a hope that she makes a surprise appearance as an older version of herself in one of these animated series episodes to come.

When Does Ted: The Animated Series Come Out?

Ted: The Animated Series will be making its debut with Peacock on Thursday, December 17th with eight episodes all available at once. Additional episodes of the animated series planned for a release sometime in 2027, but no concrete release date has been announced as of this time. The core cast of the films are returning to reprise their respective roles with Seth MacFarlane as Ted, Mark Wahlberg as John, Amanda Seyfried as Sam, and Jessica Barth as Tami-Lynn all set alongside new additions Kyle Mooney as Apollo and Liz Richman as Ruth.

With the Ted franchise continuing its story through the animated series, it unfortunately means that the live-action TV series is likely not going to return anytime soon. Seth MacFarlane noted that while the production team and Peacock had deemed the series a success, it was just “too expensive” to keep producing . So it seems like this animated series might be the only way forward for now. How do you feel about Matty and Susan returning in Ted: The Animated Series without Blaire? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Pero Pero★Sparkles Anime's Promo Video Reveals January 10 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yurie Sekiya 's Pero Pero★Sparkles characters began streaming on Wednesday a promotional video, and it reveals that the anime will premiere on January 10 at 7:00 a.m. JST on the "Animori!" programming block on TV Tokyo and its affiliates:

The cast includes:

• Yuki Sakakihara as Mero

• Mai Kanno as Kyun

• Ai Fairouz as Ru

• Yōhei Azakami as Narrator

Mao Miyashita is directing the anime at Usagiou , and Yūji Umoto is in charge of the series scripts. Shiomi Yano is designing the characters, while Yui Ōzaki is the art director. Saya Fukase is directing the sound, and Shōta Kowashi is composing the music with TV Tokyo Music producing the music.

Sekiya launched the characters in 2013, and the characters have since spawned merchandise, as well as a 2020 YouTube anime.

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 Confirms Release Date Ahead of Shonen Jump Finale – Watch Trailer
content:
Sakamoto Days might be gearing up to release the final chapter of its manga with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump this weekend , but the anime has now set a release date for its Season 2 return with a new trailer showing off the action. Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days is set to end its six year run with Shonen Jump , and the franchise is going out on a high with a huge final battle that’s brought the series back to its roots. As for the anime, it’s also been revitalized in turn as well.

Sakamoto Days Season 2 was previously announced to be making its debut sometime next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , and now a January 18th release date has been set for the new episodes. There have been some changes behind the scenes to lead the new season looking a lot different than the first season, and there’s no better example of all of that in motion with a new trailer showing off what’s next. You can check it out below.

When Does Sakamoto Days Season 2 Come Out?

Sakamoto Days Season 2 will be making its debut on January 18th in Japan as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, and will be streaming worldwide with Netflix when it hits . That’s also where you can catch up with everything that’s happened in the first season so far, and that’s going to be necessary as this second season is going to drop fans right back into the thick of an intense arc. Revealed with this first trailer is the new opening theme titled “Papa wa Imada ni Juvenile” as performed by Creepy Nuts, the viral band behind themes seen with Mashle: Magic and Muscles, DAN DA DAN and more.

New additions to the voice cast revealed with this trailer are Kenyu Horiuchi as Byodo and Kisho Taniyama as Club Jam, and they join previously announced new additions Kikunosuke Toya as Amane, Misa Watanabe as Etsuko Satoda, and Shinshu Fujii as Yotsumura. The voice cast from the first season will be returning to reprise their respective roles, but there have been some changes behind the scenes with a shift in the production staff for this new Sakamoto Days season .

What’s New for Sakamoto Days Season 2?

Daisuke Nakajima is taking over as director for Sakamoto Days Season 2 for TMS Entertainment, with Season One director Masaki Watanabe serving as supervising director. Taku Kishimoto returns from the first season to handle the scripts, Yo Moriyama returns to provide the character designs, and Yuki Hayashi returns to compose the music. But as demonstrated with this new trailer, the action seems to have been better established this time around compared to when the anime first began.

The second half of Sakamoto Days’ debut season had been received much better than the first, and this second season is teasing it will all going in that same great direction. If you dropped off from the anime for whatever reason, this is now the perfect time to catch up with it all before the new season hits. Especially as the manga’s story gets ready to end . But how are you liking the Sakamoto Days anime so far? What do you want to see in Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

That’s also where you can catch up with everything that’s happened in the first season so far, and that’s going to be necessary as this second season is going to drop fans right back into the thick of an intense arc. Revealed with this first trailer is the new opening theme titled “Papa wa Imada ni Juvenile” as performed by Creepy Nuts, the viral band behind themes seen with Mashle: Magic and Muscles, DAN DA DAN and more.

New additions to the voice cast revealed with this trailer are Kenyu Horiuchi as Byodo and Kisho Taniyama as Club Jam, and they join previously announced new additions Kikunosuke Toya as Amane, Misa Watanabe as Etsuko Satoda, and Shinshu Fujii as Yotsumura. The voice cast from the first season will be returning to reprise their respective roles, but there have been some changes behind the scenes with a shift in the production staff for this new Sakamoto Days season .
What’s New for Sakamoto Days Season 2?

Daisuke Nakajima is taking over as director for Sakamoto Days Season 2 for TMS Entertainment, with Season One director Masaki Watanabe serving as supervising director. Taku Kishimoto returns from the first season to handle the scripts, Yo Moriyama returns to provide the character designs, and Yuki Hayashi returns to compose the music. But as demonstrated with this new trailer, the action seems to have been better established this time around compared to when the anime first began.

The second half of Sakamoto Days’ debut season had been received much better than the first, and this second season is teasing it will all going in that same great direction. If you dropped off from the anime for whatever reason, this is now the perfect time to catch up with it all before the new season hits. Especially as the manga’s story gets ready to end . But how are you liking the Sakamoto Days anime so far? What do you want to see in Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time's the Charm Anime Announced for 2027, Reveals Main Cast and Teaser Visual
content:
KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time’s the Charm TV anime adaptation was officially announced for 2027, revealing a teaser visual, main cast, and staff.

The story follows Alphina, a duke’s daughter who has repeated the same life 99 times. Each loop ends after she is falsely accused of attempting to assassinate a Saint, has her engagement broken by Prince Lionett, and is executed. During her 100th life, Alphina suddenly gains the ability to hear the inner thoughts of those around her, revealing that the people she believed hated her may feel very differently.

The main cast includes:

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Alphina

• Kazuki Ura as Lionett

The main staff working on the anime:

• Original Work: Yuji Yuji

• Original Character Design: Nami Hidaka

• Comic Adaptation: Roharu Kai

• Chief Director: Sayaka Yamai

• Director: Baoning Wen

• Series Composition: Deko Akao

• Character Design: Miwa Ohshima

• Music Production: PONY CANYON

• Produced by: GOOD SMILE FILM

• Animation Production: XINGFU

Ikumi Hasegawa commented:

I’m Ikumi Hasegawa, and I’ll be the voice of Alphina. As the title suggests, Alphina is the duke’s daughter who has been executed 99 times. That’s exactly why her enlightened-sounding words and actions are so entertaining—combined with her naturally spirited side, she’s a captivating girl you just can’t take your eyes off. In her 100th life, she suddenly finds herself able to hear the inner thoughts of those around her…!? As a result, this work features a mix of dialogue and inner monologues. The staff is doing their best to make sure we can perform comfortably on set, and they’re handling the voice recording sessions with great care. The “dual sides” of the characters surrounding Alphina are just so fascinating and endearing! Be sure to stay tuned! ♪

Kazuki Ura commented:

I’m Kazuki Ura, and I’ll be the voice of Lionett. When I first read this series, I was struck by how unique and extraordinary all the characters were, and I was almost certain that the voice recording sessions would be a lot of fun—so I’m absolutely excited to be a part of it! Lionett was born into royalty and is a man so feared that he’s known as “His cold-hearted Prince,” but deep down, he seems to be a little… different? I hope you’ll enjoy seeing him and everyone’s inner thoughts in the anime as well!

The anime is based on Yuji Yuji and Nami Hidaka’s light novel The 100th Time’s the Charm: She Was Executed 99 Times, So How Did She Unlock “Super Love” Mode?! The series currently has three volumes published under Drecom’s DRE Novels label, while a manga adaptation by Roharu Kai is serialized through DRE Comics. The franchise has over 500,000 copies in circulation.

title: KuKu-Loop: The 100th Time's the Charm Anime Reveals Main Cast, Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content:
Pony Canyon revealed the teaser visual, main cast and staff, and 2027 premiere for KUKU-LOOP: The 100th Time's the Charm , the anime of storywriter Yūji Yūji and illustrator Nami Hidaka 's The 100th Time's the Charm: She Was Executed 99 Times, So How Did She Unlock “Super Love” Mode?! light novel series, on Wednesday. The anime's official website also opened on Wednesday and confirmed its television format.

The anime will star Ikumi Hasegawa as protagonist Alphina, and Kazuki Ura as Lionett.

Sayaka Yamai ( Dungeon People , Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right director) is the chief director, and Bao Ning Wen ( Dad is a Hero, Mom is a Spirit, I'm a Reincarnator episode director) is directing the anime at XINGFU . Deko Akao ( The Detective Is Already Dead two seasons, Komi Can't Communicate two seasons) is in charge of series scripts, Miwa Ōshima ( Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts , My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! ) is designing the characters, and Pony Canyon is in charge of music production. Good Smile Film is producing the anime.

J-Novel Club releases the novels in English and describes the story:

Alphina is falsely accused of plotting to assassinate Saint Debonaire. Time rewinds every time she's executed for a crime she didn't commit, but with the cruel Saint Debonaire against her, the same fate awaits Alphina ninety-nine times in a row: death by decapitation. But something different happens the hundredth time around. Just as Alphina is preparing herself for yet another execution, she discovers that she can hear people's true feelings—and that everyone secretly loves her! Can Alphina take advantage of her newfound ability and sidestep her fate at the guillotine?

Roharu Kai launched a manga adaptation in June 2023 on Drecom 's website. J-Novel Club is also releasing the manga in English.

title: Spice and Wolf Season 2 Announces January 2027 Premiere
content:
Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF Season 2 announced that the sequel is set to premiere in January 2027. Studio Passione is animating the remake, which also included an arc that wasn’t in the original anime. The first season concluded in September 2024 and the sequel was announced immediately. A new key visual was also revealed:

Takeo Takahashi and Hijiri Sanpei are the chief directors while Nobuyoshi Nagayama and Takahiro Majima are the directors. Koji Haneda and Satona Sugimoto are illustrating the character designs and Kevin Penkin composes the music. The voice cast consists of:

• Ami Koshimizu as Holo

• Jun Fukuyama as Kraft Lawrence

• Mai Nakahara as Norah Arendt

• Saeko Chiba as Fermi Amati

• Hochu Otsuka as Marhait Liechten

• Aimi Tanaka as Myuuri

• Hozumi Goda as Hans Remerio

• Akeno Watanabe as Dian Rubens

• Shinpachi Tsuji as Jacob Tarantino

The first Spice and Wolf anime was animated by studio Imagin and aired in the Winter 2008 anime season through 12 episodes. It received an OVA episode in May of the same year. A second OVA was released in May 2009, and a second 12-episode season by studios Marvy Jack and Brain’s Base aired in the summer of that year.

Isuna Haekura wrote the Spice and Wolf light novel series, which featured illustrations by Jyuu Ayakura. ASCII Media Works published it from 2006 to 2019, releasing a total of 22 volumes. A manga adaptation by Keito Koume ran from September 2007 to December 2017. A sequel novel titled Wolf and Parchment written by Hasekura and illustrated by Hidori is ongoing. Yen Press licensed both the original series and the sequel. Crunchyroll is streaming Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF . The story follows Kraft Lawrence, a traveling merchant who meets Holo the Wisewolf, a god who brings bountiful harvests. Together they embark on a journey, encountering all kinds of people and events.
